description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Order to declare 15th April 2016 a Public Holiday on account of the Sinhala & Tamil New Year, 2016
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971, declaring a specific day as a Public Holiday. It is a statutory instrument and a legal notice issued by a Minister using powers vested by an existing Act of Parliament. This fits the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), which includes "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "legal notices." While a Minister is named, the primary purpose is not about the government personnel or their portfolio responsibilities, but about establishing a legal/regulatory directive.
